title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Vehicle Value the Floor Is Figured On
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 worksheet benefit.** The vehicle value the worksheet benefit's floor is figured on follows the contract's Collateral Protection Insurance tracking record.

| Tracking record | Vehicle value for the floor |
|---|---|
| a placement notice is on record | the vehicle value the record set at that placement |
| the record holds only the vehicle value it opened with | the lower of that value and the book value at origination |
| the contract has no tracking record | the book value at origination |

*Hypothetical case.* The tracking record opened with a vehicle value of 12400.00 and shows no placement notice. The book value at origination is 13000.00. The floor is figured on 12400.00, the lower of the two.
